country_setting: China (Suining Central Hospital, Suining, Sichuan)
question_source: scenarios (20 curated, de-identified, translated clinical cases structured in a fixed clinical sequence, evenly distributed across IWGDF risk categories 0-3)

notes: No harmful recommendation or prespecified major safety error in primary outputs (0/100 overall; Results text), hence 0/20 per interface on primary outputs. Interfaces evaluated 4-5 August 2026 under recorded no-search conditions.
